notes.title: Balance Update
notes.content:
[h1]A new rhythm of battle for the master of swordplay—[/h1]

We've implemented balance adjustments to bring greater tactical depth to Karina, the iconic close-combat archetype character. We're introducing a new mechanic called "The Breathing Rhythm of Draw and Sheath" to her previously unlimited sword techniques.

[u][b]A New Cadence in Swordsmanship[/b][/u]
Kalyna's sword attacks are now limited to a maximum of 4 consecutive strikes. After the fourth strike, she must sheathe her sword and charge for a moment before unleashing her next slash. This change shifts the focus from endless sword swinging to a more strategic interplay between offense and spacing. Players must now master the swordsman's sense of "timing" for a more tactical combat style.
Magic Consumption and Balance Optimization
[list]
[*] Ultimate Enhancement Magic MP Cost: 50 → 100
[*] Ultimate Sword Magic Attack Power: 10 → 7
[*] Sword Enhancement Magic Duration: 60 seconds → 30 seconds
[/list]

These adjustments make magic management and timing crucial for Karina players. Whether to unleash a powerful strike or maintain sustained combat—situational judgment will now determine victory or defeat.
This update isn't about weakening Kalyna, but rather providing a deeper combat experience. The tension of sheathing your blade, the anticipation of the next strike—forge new legends on the battlefield with the evolved Kalyna.

notes.title: Major Update: “Archetype Awakening”
notes.content:
Clashing blades, rapid‑fire magic, and unmistakable individuality—
In this major update, every playable character gains a vivid identity with three new archetypes: Balanced, Specialized, and Close‑Combat.
Until now, Akpala’s mages excelled at waving their staves and casting spells from afar. From today forward, sword‑wielding vanguards and barrage casters who unload volleys of mana projectiles will join them on the field. Heftier weapons, punchier spells, and far broader tactical options—all of this comes with the “Archetype Awakening” update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44603187/00c7a26968b19c0505fac843bb6625a0c4922009.png[/img]

[h2]New Combat Styles by Character[/h2]
Two characters—one from the Angel faction and one from the Demon faction—represent the Balanced archetype, retaining the familiar blend of offense and defense. The Specialized archetype now features a slow but powerful melee mage, while the Close‑Combat archetype introduces knife‑masters and swordfighters who magically enhance their blades. Close‑Combat characters fight primarily with the newly‑added swords, sprinting across the battlefield while unleashing ultimate spells.

[h2]Gameplay & Balance Overhaul[/h2]
With the arrival of archetypes, we have completely re‑evaluated hit‑boxes, movement speeds, and weapon‑attachment ranges.

[h2]New Spells & Weapons[/h2]
The scimitar and daggers—icons of the Close‑Combat archetype—now sport color‑shifting trails and emissive effects that make every slash feel substantial. Another Specialized character gains new spells: a shock‑wave that wipes out nearby foes at the cost of slower movement, and a multi‑shot straight‑line burst.

[h2]Enhanced VR Experience[/h2]
Hand‑tracking latency is tuned per weapon: swords feel weighty, while staves remain light and responsive.

Final Words
“Archetype Awakening” does more than expand Akpala’s battlefields—it fundamentally redefines how each player fights. Will you grasp a gleaming sword, unleash overwhelming arcane power, or adapt fluidly to any situation? The choice is yours. Install the latest build and explore fresh tactics in the evolved world of Akpala. We welcome your feedback and bug reports on the Steam forums or in our Discord server.

See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Game Update: New Scoreboard System and Flight Magic Balance
notes.content:
We're excited to announce two important updates to enhance your gaming experience:
[h2]Global Scoreboard System[/h2]
The training area scoreboard in the lobby has been completely revamped! Previously, you could only compete for scores within rooms you created. Now, you can compete with players from around the world! Daily, weekly, and monthly rankings will be recorded, so put your nickname on the board and aim for the top scores!
[h2]Flight Magic Balancing[/h2]
We've made strategic changes to flight magic in multiplayer battles. Flight magic is now enabled or disabled depending on the stage:

[list]
[*] Flight magic is disabled on voxel-type stages where building is possible, ensuring that construction elements remain meaningful and strategic
[*] Flight magic is enabled on all other maps, allowing for free movement
[/list]

These changes will require more stage-specific strategies, adding depth to your gameplay experience.

notes.content:
[h1]New Feature: Spectator Mode Added[/h1]

In previous versions of our multiplayer mode, players were prohibited from joining ongoing battles after stage selection in the lobby. With this update, we've not only enabled mid-game entry but also added a spectator feature.

Players who join mid-battle will be sent to a spectator area where they can watch the combat from an overhead view. Rest assured, you'll be able to participate in battles after the current match concludes.

We expect this change to significantly increase the frequency of match availability.

notes.title: March 1, 2025 - Major Multiplayer Update

The Card System has arrived in multiplayer battles!
The system has been changed from the previous format where random abilities were granted upon obtaining a Black Orb, to a new card-based system. Now, you can hold abilities as cards and activate them at any time you choose.
This allows for more strategic planning and adds depth to battles. Using the right card at the right moment will be the key to victory.

Two new stages have been added to multiplayer!
[olist]

In the dimly lit underground sewer, enjoy intense battles on limited platforms while trying not to fall into the water. Experience thrilling tactics in this tension-filled environment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44603187/3e79cc3c580a8fde327671bd04b665d604848bf3.png[/img]

The Ship Town stage features large ships and a warehouse district where you can use numerous obstacles to defeat your enemies. Strategic gameplay is possible by taking advantage of the diverse terrain.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44603187/079ac6de7ce280364a2cc8c977bb7084aa4ecb23.png[/img]

notes.title: MATCHMAKING IMPROVEMENTS & GAME UPDATES
notes.content:
This week, while our focus remains on the upcoming single-player mode update, we’ve been preparing for a major multiplayer update that significantly improves the game. Here’s what’s coming:

[b]Network Processing Optimization[/b]

We’ve made a big leap in optimizing the network processing for multiplayer mode. Previously, players experienced issues with lag, especially in overseas matches. With this update, we’ve reduced the network processing load to just one-tenth of what it was. 

[b]Closing Zone in PvP Battles[/b]

We have added a new feature to add some pace and emotion to the end of the matches. As in a Battle Royale game, a circular zone will start closing at some point during the match, and it will hurt players who stay outside of it over time. This way, players will have less coverage and hiding spots as the battle progresses, resulting in a much more frenetic gameplay. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44603187/dee2c694351a5bf5f32e81fb3da1fb7ba8e14dfd.png[/img]


[b]Future Plans[/b]

We know many of you are still waiting for our Single-Player mode to release! We are about to announce the final release date, and we apologize for the wait. However, we want to be sure that the game is in the best shape when it arrives on your VR Devices! 

You can try the first chapters of this Single-Player mode if you own Akpala’s base game, which [b]is free to install until October 31st! [/b]

We appreciate your patience!

Stay tuned for more updates, and thanks for your support!

notes.title: SINGLE PLAYER is coming to AKPALA
notes.content:
Greetings, Duelists!

Thank you for playing Akpala! We are truly grateful for your support, both in-game and through your feedback on social media and Discord. Thanks to you, we’ve been able to make the game even more fun.

Next week, we will be introducing our biggest update yet, finally bringing a much-requested single-player mode to Akpala! This DLC will allow everyone to experience the anime-inspired spellcasting system while progressing through the story, exploring different maps, and battling bosses, with an estimated playtime of 8 to 10 hours.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44603187/6ca4e1cb16fbcc03daaadd1c97211a152357644f.gif[/img]
[b][h3]Decide Your Fate[/h3][/b]
In this first chapter of our single-player campaign, you will step into the shoes of Castiel, a Celestial Protector. On a mission to protect someone important, Castiel faces a life-altering choice, but there’s only one thing he can do: pursue the truth.

Where this choice will lead him, and what kind of outcome awaits, is up to you to find out in this new and exciting campaign called “Tarnished Wings”!

[b][h3]Test Your Spellcasting Skills[/h3][/b]
With new locations come formidable enemies and epic bosses. Will you rise to the challenge? Master your magic words and strike with your best poses as you unleash powerful spells.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44603187/a1ac103706f7acf7d8e8837fff7220a7309fb7d6.png[/img]

What will happen in Akpala is yet to be decided. No fate has been sealed. The story will change based on your choices and how you fight, leading to different endings.

[b][h3]Smart Interactive Dialog[/h3][/b]
Our AI Engine now powers several NPCs, both friends and foes! Engage in natural, open-ended conversations to learn from your allies and outsmart your enemies.

[b][h3]Prepare for Future Battles[/h3][/b]
Akpala won’t stop here! We plan to add new stages, enemies, and even more interesting spells. And, of course, we will do the same for our multiplayer modes, ensuring the best experience no matter which you choose to play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44603187/208488b114f7506a2bc67d19eeb53258ddc2070b.png[/img]
[b][h3]A Message from the Team[/h3][/b]
It has been an exciting and satisfying journey since we first started this project. We're more eager than ever to keep improving and delivering the best experience for those who support and walk this path with us.

As always, we would love to hear your thoughts and feedback. Join us on our Discord server, share your experiences, and make some friends—you might need them in battle!

See you in Akpala!

The Development Team

notes.title: Update: Health System Implementation, Character Movement Enhancements
notes.content:
[h1][b]Update Contents:[/b][/h1]

[h2]Introduction of a health system in multiplayer battles[/h2]
Previously, players would lose if hit by any spell, regardless of its type. With this update, we have set the health value to 30.
Regular spells now deal 10 damage, effectively allowing players to withstand up to three hits before being defeated.
Note that certain spells (ultimate spells) deal 30 damage, allowing for a one-hit knockout if successfully landed.

[h2]Improved character movements[/h2]
We have updated the overall animation for character movements.
Notably, by incorporating procedural techniques, characters now take steps in response to your movements.
This not only enhances communication with other players but also allows for more expressive animations in e-act Chater, which features a spectator mode.

Other updates include fine-tuning of the tutorial mode and improvements to AI functionality.
These changes have significantly enhanced the tutorial mode experience.

notes.title: Update on New Features and Matchmaking Improvements
notes.content:
Good evening.
We have created our first VR online multiplayer game, but we noticed an issue. Specifically, during these initial stages (right now), we are facing the problem of not being able to find players for online matches. We have considered several solutions:

Send notifications when someone is waiting for a match on the official Discord server.
We believe this will help alleviate the issue of players being spread out across different time zones, resulting in unsuccessful matchmaking. This feature has been implemented in our latest update, so please utilize it. Here's the Discord server invitation: https://discord.gg/XGDc7CGw9b. Notifications can be received in the "matchmaking-alerts" channel.

Introduce a feature in the waiting lobby that allows individual players to pass the time, like a practice area.
We think this can ease the discomfort players might feel while waiting for a match. We plan to introduce various enemy characters, creating something similar to a shooting game. We aim to release this feature in an update later this month.

Preparation for 1vs1 quick matches.
Currently, we are revisiting our matchmaking system. We believe this will make it easier for individuals to enjoy the gaming experience. We are planning to implement this feature as soon as possible, so please bear with us a little longer.

RedefineArts
